theorems.name: Submission.adjoint_comp_fderiv_contDiffOn_fderiv_eq_add
theorems.statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (V : Set (Rn n)) (ψ : Rn n → Rn N), IsOpen V → ContDiffOn ℝ 2 ψ V → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun x ↦ ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (fderiv ℝ ψ x) ∘L fderiv ℝ ψ x) V ∧ ∀ x ∈ V, ∀ v : Rn n, fderiv ℝ (fun x ↦ ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (fderiv ℝ ψ x) ∘L fderiv ℝ ψ x) x v = ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (fderiv ℝ ψ x) ∘L fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ ψ) x v + ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ ψ) x v) ∘L fderiv ℝ ψ x
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
